ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Qul Huwa Nab'un 'Azeem' in Surah Sad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the gravity of the Quranic revelation as a 'great news' (Naba' Azim) concerning the Hereafter, often linked to the concept of *Tawhid* and the ultimate destiny of the faithful. It serves as a rhetorical device to capture the attention of the disbelievers, emphasizing that the message is not merely historical but a decisive divine decree. The phrase highlights the authority of the Prophet (SAWW) as the bearer of this monumental truth, reinforcing the certainty of resurrection and judgment.
